'''Volahn''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], commander of the ''[[Equity]]''.

==Biography==
Volahn's fleet ambushed [[Gaen Drommel]]'s [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] when it emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and Volahn ordered Drommel's surrender. Drommel refused, but was killed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gastos Niovi|Niovi]], who surrendered the ''Guardian''.
